name: Iron Saddleguard
description: Sets the blade's hollow back against the forearm and holds a firm guard on qi from open meridians.

name: Iron Flaretip
description: Roots the stance and drops the belly from shoulder to hip in one pulse of qi.

name: Ironrake
description: Turns the hip after a cut and brings the blade back around in a crescent at the ribs.

name: Torrent Swellback
description: Steps clear of a straight attack with qi snapping through the legs.

name: Mantled Flowedge
description: Turns the blade under pressure with a stream of qi so the curve carries a heavy cut off the line.

name: Raketorment
description: Crosses two cuts in a scissor motion that opens a guard from both sides at once.

name: Rumble Talwar
description: Thickens the qi around the wrist at impact to carry the cut through a raised guard.

name: Splintering Rake
description: Flings a crescent of qi from the curve of the blade along a single clean line at a distant foe.

name: Irontalwar
description: Spins the blade in front of the body to raise a rolling wall of cutting qi that deflects missiles.

name: Charter Deepbelly
description: Holds the guard while qi spreads in a quiet field one arm's length around the body.

name: Rumble Carve
description: Cuts the forehand with the field pressing ahead of the edge to clear the target's guard.

name: Gustcarve
description: Mirrors the forehand with the field leaning toward the backhand line.

name: Silt Scimhilt
description: Plants each foot where the field has already felt the ground and the foe's weight.

name: Waning Crescent
description: Reads the foe's blade by the ripple of the field before the steel touches it.

name: Rumble Broadcurve
description: Glides the edge along the field's edge so that the cut gains reach without losing weight.

name: Gustlip
description: Turns a parry into a push of the field that shoves the opposing blade off line.

name: Might Whipcut
description: Drags the edge through the field and through a second guard held behind the first.

name: Lancing Lop
description: Swings the belly in a wide arc so the whole field cuts across several nearby foes together.

name: Cantle Fastness
description: Draws the field tight against the body and holds it as a shield against incoming steel.

name: Facetcantle
description: Guards with every meridian carrying qi so the blade holds against a shock without slowing.

name: Rumble Arcwheel
description: Drives qi down both arms into a single arc that finishes at the opponent's flank.

name: Crescent Leap
description: Spirals the feet backward in a corkscrew so the edge stays between the foe and the body.

name: Suppressing Lop
description: Locks the opponent's wrist with the hooked point and pulls the weapon from their grip.

name: Might Broadcurve
description: Sustains qi along the blade through a draw that runs the full length of the target.

name: Scooptorment
description: Slides the hooked point into an armour seam and tears it open with a twist of the wrist.

name: Ironlip
description: Whirls the blade in unbroken loops with qi flowing through every limb and every cut linked to the next.

name: Facetscoop
description: Drives the hooked point with concentrated qi through a gap in plate and leather alike.

name: Annealed Swellback
description: Grounds the stance with the field settled low and the blade held across the front.

name: Granite Flowedge
description: Reaches over the guard with the belly of the blade and the field behind it.

name: Might Scimhilt
description: Hooks the point round the ankle and pulls the foot out from under the foe.

name: Might Deepbelly
description: Slips between two attackers on the field's sense of where each will move.

name: Talwarcloak
description: Draws the blade clear of a bind and returns it as a guard in the same breath.

name: Blazetalwar
description: Lunges across the gap with the field shortening the distance by half a pace.

name: Liptorment
description: Rolls qi from shoulder to point in a wave so the cut lengthens as it lands.

name: Ponderous Scoop
description: Pins the foe's blade to the ground with the spine and the weight of the field.

name: Tempered Carve
description: Lifts the point in a tight rising curve that stops a finger from the throat.

name: Chime Cantle
description: Circles the edge before the body so that thrusts and cuts both slide aside.

name: Glint Rake
description: Sends the tail of a sweeping cut past the blade's reach as a thin line of qi.

name: Alternating Saddleguard
description: Chains field and steel in a wheel of linked cuts so that no gap opens between them.

name: Aegistalwar
description: Opens with one track guarding and the other ready to strike in the kingdom's pairing.

name: Flaretip Onslaught
description: Cuts from the hip twice along matched lines so the second covers what the first missed.

name: Whipping Talwar
description: Steps left and then right in a mirrored pair to confuse the opponent's aim.

name: Gust Cantle
description: Draws the edge up from the low guard in a long clean arc as bright as the sky.

name: Adamant Talwar
description: Meets two linked cuts with two linked parries so that none reach the body.

name: Surging Saddleguard
description: Slips onto the second track as the first is blocked and cuts from the new angle.

name: Sanguine Scoop
description: Pulls two crescent cuts on the same breath of qi with a matched stroke in each hand's time.

name: Scoopcuirass
description: Presses the foe's blade on one track while the other cuts for the wrist.

name: Staunch Deepbelly
description: Shifts the blade's weight across the body in an edge turn that doubles the parry.

name: Siltscoop
description: Cuts two crescents of qi from the blade at once to threaten a pair of adjacent foes.

name: Hardened Crescent
description: Wheels the blade in two matched rings around the body that turn aside every strike inside them.

name: Resilient Broadcurve
description: Perches high with the blade raised like a wing and the field settled around the shoulders.

name: Scalding Scimhilt
description: Drops from the raised guard in a stooping cut that carries the whole body's weight.

name: Whipping Whipcut
description: Spreads the arms wide and steps off the line as the foe's cut passes beneath.

name: Carve Hauberk
description: Catches the foe's wrist on the hooked point and pulls the hand away from the weapon.

name: Equipoise Flowedge
description: Sweeps the blade out like a pinion to beat down a thrust and open the line for a counter.

name: Blaze Scoop
description: Rises from below the guard in an upward arc that catches the foe's chin or wrist.

name: Trouncing Whipcut
description: Circles above the foe with qi building and then drops the downstroke with the whole field.

name: Glint Flaretip
description: Falls on the foe from height and drives the edge through a raised guard with the full field.

name: Torrent Broadcurve
description: Wheels the blade upward in a rising wheel that lifts and throws aside a heavy attack.

name: Unflinching Flowedge
description: Stands like a river bank with the blade low and still to take the first blow.

name: Furrowing Rake
description: Cuts low across the shins like water along the floor of a basin.

name: Granite Arcwheel
description: Follows the opponent's drift like a current and keeps the blade just behind it.

name: Hardened Scimhilt
description: Turns in a small eddy that sends the foe's cut around the body.

name: Rumble Swellback
description: Sends a first cut and a second after it like rings on still water.

name: Tempered Scoop
description: Rises through the target in a draw that builds like a flood and breaks the guard at its height.

name: Dominating Rake
description: Hooks the foe's blade beneath the guard and presses it down as a weir stops a stream.

name: Raging Flaretip
description: Turns the foe's cut back on itself and sends the return cut along the same current.

name: Blaze Cantle
description: Pours paired cuts from both sides to fill the space around the foes and leave nowhere to stand.

name: Fastening Saddleguard
description: Hooks the foe's weapon arm and drags it along the ground like a stone pulled through a current.

name: Aegis Deepbelly
description: Holds a still guard in a field of clear qi with both lines open to be read.

name: Lop Maelstrom
description: Cuts the first of the two lines across the foe's shoulder in a flat arc.

name: Mightlip
description: Follows with the second line down the opposite diagonal before the first can be answered.

name: Gust Talwar
description: Pivots on one foot and retreats along the second line with the blade covering both.

name: Carvetorment
description: Presses through a guard by cutting both lines on the same breath of qi.

name: Lipcloak
description: Holds one line against the foe's cut and answers on the other without breaking the guard.

name: Rupturing Nova Carve
description: Cuts both lines through the same point and drives the combined stroke through a hardened guard.

name: Aegis Flaretip
description: Raises two interlocked fields along the lines of the cuts to hold off a heavy assault.

name: Iron Swellback
description: Opens facing the wind with the blade tilted so the breeze runs along the flat.

name: Might Lop
description: Takes a bearing on the target before the cut and holds the line to its end.

name: Silttalwar
description: Steps into the crosswind so the draught carries the blade's weight toward the foe.

name: Murkcantle
description: Parries from the edge of the stance so the foe's blade falls off the line like a stone off a cliff.

name: Gustrake
description: Holds the backhand to its sworn line even when the foe's feint pulls at the arm.

name: Hastening Arcwheel
description: Advances on a shallow breath held until the cut is finished.

name: Crescent Maelstrom
description: Draws the blade along a bearing fixed in advance with qi extending the cut beyond the steel.

name: Liphauberk
description: Turns the guard to break the wind of the foe's cut and send it by the shoulder.

name: Cantlecloak
description: Hooks the foe's weapon on a gust of qi and rips it sideways from the hand.

name: Harrowing Flowedge
description: Takes the foe's own bearing and cuts back along it faster than the foe can turn.

name: Cleaving Arcwheel
description: Throws a blade of wind-shaped qi from the sweeping edge along the sworn bearing.

name: Unyielding Hoarfrost Saddleguard
description: Spins the blade to stir a ring of wind that turns away blows without a wall.

name: Granite Crescent
description: Stands square on flat ground with the blade held across the front and the field open.

name: Sanguine Broadcurve
description: Holds the bearing through a high overcut that does not drift with the foe's feint.

name: Gust Whipcut
description: Steps to the edge of the stance and lets the attack pass over empty ground.

name: Iron Cantle
description: Runs a low hook along the ground like the draught across the plateau.

name: Immovable Swellback
description: Beats the foe's bearing off its line with a hard parry that rings along the blade.

name: Tempered Scimhilt
description: Pulls the edge through the foe with the field running its length for extra bite.

name: Manacling Talwar
description: Hooks the foe's lead arm and throws them along the bearing the blade was set on.

name: Transfixing Rake
description: Cuts a wide level arc across open ground that threatens every foe standing in the line.

name: Hoarfrost Swellback
description: Holds the field along the bearing so that nothing crosses the line to the body.

name: Cantleplating
description: Stands in open ground with no cover behind and the guard held wide.

name: Blazelip
description: Begins every bout with a sworn cut at the shoulder that gives the foe no time to settle.

name: Torrent Lop
description: Pivots through the full circle of open ground and keeps the foe in front.

name: Hardened Flaretip
description: Slides the parry down the wind side of the blade and out past the foe's shoulder.

name: Rupturing Deepbelly
description: Carries the backhand through whatever the foe does and finishes where it began.

name: Sanguine Whipcut
description: Slashes back at once from an unsheltered stance on the foe's rising cut.

name: Ironcarve
description: Holds a sworn line through a long cut with qi laid along the full length of the edge.

name: Thorn Crescent
description: Catches a heavy blow on the flat while a breath of qi braces the whole arm.

name: Thorncantle
description: Rolls the hook over the foe's blade and snaps it down into the ground.

name: Rumble Cantle
description: Drives a single sworn cut with qi at the point through the foe's hardest guard.

name: Unflinching Deepbelly
description: Holds a standing guard in a lean of the wind that withstands a rush of several foes.

name: Annealed Flowedge
description: Sets the guard along the line the gale is running and holds the stance there.

name: Saddleguard Assault
description: Times an overcut to the push of the gale so the wind adds speed to the stroke.

name: Carvepounce
description: Shortens the step against a headwind so the blade stays on the bearing.

name: Mayhemcarve
description: Checks the foe's lead wrist with the windward edge and turns it off the bearing.

name: Scoop Barrage
description: Rides the tailwind through a long slash that ends well past the foe.

name: Gust Scimhilt
description: Tempers the parry on a steady stream of qi so the gale itself pushes the foe's blade aside.

name: Thornrake
description: Hooks the foe's blade through a buffeting squall and holds it fast along the original bearing.

name: Drubbing Broadcurve
description: Draws the edge along the gale line with qi gathered in the belly for a clean finishing pull.

name: Granite Talwar
description: Releases the gale gathered along the curve in one broad cut that sweeps every foe in its line.

name: Thorn Flowedge
description: Commands the wind around the blade to hold a bearing that no strike can cross.
